title: Bekenstein-Hawking temperature from the Schwarzian
summary: Hawking's original derivation of particle creation by black holes in Schwarzschild spacetime exploits, among various concepts, the exponential dependence on the retarded time variable u of the affine parameter λof the null geodesics that are integral curves of the null vector field orthogonal to the Killing horizon. This exponential law implies that the Schwarzian derivative of λwith respect to u is minus a half the square of surface gravity.
